svg.aria-label: Testing pyramid: static checks (types and lint) as the foundation, then unit tests (about 80% of tests, milliseconds, run after every edit), integration tests (about 15%, real database and API clients over a fake network), and end-to-end tests at the top (about 5%, critical user journeys in a real browser, slowest and flakiest).
svg.text: Critical journeys in a real browser
the foundation the tests stand on
No test needs to repeat it
Most tests sit at the bottom. Each layer catches what the layers below it cannot.
